name: dedicator of cytokinesis 8
pathways: regulation of Rho protein signal transduction

function.text: DOCK8 encodes dedicator of cytokinesis protein 8. Annotated molecular activities include guanyl-nucleotide exchange factor activity. It participates in small GTPase-mediated signal transduction and regulation of Rho protein signal transduction.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to combined immunodeficiency due to DOCK8 deficiency (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
